遠坂とイリヤの様子を見に行こう。
二人が何をしているのか興味あるし、俺に手伝える事があるかもしれない。

pages.en:
I'll go see how Tohsaka and Illya are doing.

I'm curious what they are working on, and perhaps there is something I can do to help.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’ll go see how Tohsaka and Illya are doing.
I’m curious about what they’re up to, and there might be something I can help with.

pages.ja:
「そんなのないわよ。邪魔だから出て行って」
と。
客間をノックしてから一秒、反撃の余地すらなく一刀両断された。
pages.jaRuby:
「そんなのないわよ。邪魔だから出て行って」

pages.en:
“There isn't. You're in the way, so leave.”

One second after I knock on the guest-room door, she cuts me down without leaving the slightest opening for a counterattack.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Nope. You’re just a bother, so get out of here.”
Then.
One second after I knock, she kicks me out without time for a rebuttal.

pages.ja: 「む、なんだよその態度。人の善意を足蹴にすると後が怖いぞ」
pages.jaRuby: 「む、なんだよその態度。人の善意を足蹴にすると後が怖いぞ」
pages.en: “Hey, what kind of attitude is that? Trampling on someone's goodwill is liable to come back and haunt you.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Hey, what’s with that attitude? It could get scary later if you kick away someone’s goodwill.”

pages.ja:
「なにが善意よ。今からするのは遠坂とアインツベルンの秘門なんだから、他の人間に見せられるワケないでしょ。
手伝いたいって気持ちは嬉しいけど、わたしとイリヤにとっちゃ士郎の行動は害悪そのものなの。貴方だって、自分の家の秘密を他所に知られたくないでしょ」
pages.jaRuby:
「なにが善意よ。今からするのは遠坂とアインツベルンの秘門なんだから、他の人間に見せられるワケないでしょ。
手伝いたいって気持ちは嬉しいけど、わたしとイリヤにとっちゃ士郎の行動は害悪そのものなの。貴方だって、自分の家の秘密を他所に知られたくないでしょ」
pages.en:
“What goodwill? We're about to perform secret arts of the Tohsaka and Einzbern families. Obviously we can't show them to an outsider.

“I appreciate that you want to help, but to Illya and me, anything you did would be actively harmful. You wouldn't want strangers learning your own family's secrets, would you?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What goodwill? We’re going to be using the Tohsaka and Einzbern’s secret magic, so there’s no way we can show it to other people.
I’m glad to know you want to help, but your behavior itself is harmful. I’m sure you don’t want us finding out about your secrets, right?”

」
……なるほど。
言われてみれば確かにその通り。
いくら協力体制とは言え、どうあっても教えられない事もある。
それはともかく。

“————”

…I see.

Now that she mentions it, she is perfectly right.

However closely we cooperate, some things simply cannot be shared.

That aside—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
…I see.
When she puts it that way, I see her point.
There are things I can’t tell her, even if we’re cooperating.
Anyway.

pages.en:
“Tohsaka. Why are you wearing glasses?”

“…Why? What, do they look strange?”

“No, not strange. More like—”

Her honor-student aura has risen another level. She looks like the student council president now.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsaka. Why are you wearing glasses?”
“…Why? …What, does it look funny?”
“Well, it’s not funny, but”
Her honor student style has upgraded, and she looks like some president now.

すごく、似合ってる」

“—They look really good on you.”

“—! I-I see. I only wear glasses when I'm alone, so I wouldn't know… You're sure they don't look odd?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It really suits you.”
“…I-I see. I don’t really know because I only wear glasses when I’m alone, but… it doesn’t look funny?”

pages.mirrorMoon:
“No. I might be tricked into believing that you’re an honor student even though I know your true nature. Are you trying to hide your character?”

「遠坂？ なんか、妙に背中がゾクゾクしてるんだが」
気のせいだろうか、と視線で訊いてみる。
「あら奇遇ね。わたしも肩が震えてるのよ衛宮くん。
そろそろ本気で、一度白黒つけなくちゃいけないって思ったトコ。うろちょろ歩き回れるぐらい暇なら、動けなくなるまで鍛えてあげましょうか？」

pages.en:
“Tohsaka? I'm getting a peculiar chill down my back.”

I look at her, asking whether I imagined it.

“What a coincidence. My shoulders are trembling too, Emiya.

“I was just thinking it's about time we settled things once and for all. If you have enough energy to wander around underfoot, shall I train you until you can no longer move?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsaka? Um, I’m suddenly getting chills running down my back.”
I ask her with my eyes if it’s just my imagination.
“Oh, what a coincidence. My shoulders are shaking too, Emiya-kun.
I’m thinking I should settle my match with you. If you have enough free time to be walking around, how about I train you until you can’t walk?”

pages.ja:
「あ
む」
……怖い。コイツ、本気だ。
どうも、体力を温存しろと言われたクセに動き回っている俺に本気でお灸を据えたいらしい。

pages.en:
“Ah—hm.”

…Terrifying. She means it.

Apparently she genuinely intends to teach me a lesson for wandering around after being told to conserve my strength.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Uhum.”
…Scary. She’s serious.
It seems she really wants to punish me for walking around when she told me to rest and save up my energy.

pages.ja: 「……すまん、軽率だった。遠坂に言われた通り、大人しく部屋で休んでる」
pages.jaRuby: 「……すまん、軽率だった。遠坂に言われた通り、大人しく部屋で休んでる」
pages.en: “…Sorry. That was careless. I'll do as you said and rest quietly in my room.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “…Sorry, I was being careless. I’ll go rest in my room like you told me to.”

pages.ja:
「……ふん。別にいいけど、それだけ動き回れるんなら他にやる事あるんじゃない？ 士郎の助けがいるのは、何もわたしたちだけじゃないんだし」
「？ 俺の助けがいるって、何処に？」
pages.jaRuby:
「……ふん。別にいいけど、それだけ動き回れるんなら他にやる事あるんじゃない？ 士郎の助けがいるのは、何もわたしたちだけじゃないんだし」

pages.en:
“…Hmph. I suppose. But if you're well enough to move around this much, isn't there someone else who needs you? Illya and I aren't the only ones who could use your help.”

“Hm? Who needs my help?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Hmph. It’s fine, but don’t you have something else to do if you can walk around like that? We aren’t the only ones who might need your help.”
“…? Who else needs my help?”

pages.ja: 「すぐ隣り。あの子にとっちゃ士郎が傍にいるかいないかは大問題でしょ。自覚しなさい、貴方は桜の元気の素なんだから」
pages.jaRuby: 「すぐ隣り。あの子にとっちゃ士郎が傍にいるかいないかは大問題でしょ。自覚しなさい、貴方は桜の元気の素なんだから」
pages.en: “Right next door. Whether you're beside her or not matters enormously to that girl. Try to understand, Shirou—you're what keeps Sakura's spirits up.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Right in the next room. For her, having you by her side is a big deal. You should know that. You’re the source of Sakura’s energy.”

“————”

Heat rushes into my face.

Having someone state the matter so plainly is unbearably embarrassing.

“”
My face burns up.
It’s really embarrassing to have someone else say that.

「あ、うん、了解した。桜の見舞いをしていいなら、してくる」
ロボットのようにギクシャク頷く。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Ah. Right. Understood. If it's all right for me to check on Sakura, I'll go.”

I nod with the stiff, jerking movements of a robot.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, okay, I understand. If I can go see Sakura, I’m going to.”
I nod awkwardly like a robot.

pages.ja:
「していいに決まってるでしょ。
……まったく、大抵の事は大雑把なクセに、つまんないコトだけ気を利かせるんだから、ばか」
pages.jaRuby:
「していいに決まってるでしょ。

pages.en:
“Of course it's all right.

“…Honestly. You're careless about nearly everything, but then you become considerate over the most trivial things. Idiot.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Of course you can go.
…Geez, you’re usually rough, but you’re really careful in the stupidest things, idiot.”

pages.ja:
客間のドアが閉められる。
桜の部屋はすぐ隣りで、距離にして一メートルあるかないか。
pages.jaRuby:
客間のドアが閉められる。

pages.en:
The guest-room door closes.

The guest room Sakura is using is directly beside it, scarcely a meter away.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She shuts the door.
Sakura’s room is right next door, not even a meter away.

ただ様子を見に行くだけじゃないか」
大きく深呼吸をして、隣の客間のドアを睨む。
べ、別にやましい気持ちとかまったくないのだ。
俺はただ、桜がちゃんと休んでいるかどうか確かめに行くだけなんだから。

pages.en:
“Calm down. Calm down—it's only a visit to see how she's doing.”

I draw a long breath and glare at the neighboring door.

I-I harbor no improper thoughts whatsoever.

I am only going to make certain Sakura is resting properly.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Calm down, calm downI’m just going to see how she’s doing.”
I take a deep breath and glare at the door of the next room.
I-It’s not like I have a guilty conscience.
